fact: INSTAT's Annuaire statistique du Mali 2023, issued July 2025, publishes statistics compiled from ministry records: health facility reports (Annuaire SNISS 2019-2023), justice and prison records (CPS/SJ activity reports, CPS/SCJ), social services (SISo), livestock (DNPIA) and forests (DGEF) and gendarmerie road-accident counts; the 2024 edition followed in April 2026.
title: Annuaire statistique du Mali 2023
